title: Chapter 7151: I Havent Killed Him

Chapter 7151: I Havent Killed Him

Chapter 7151: I Haven't Killed Him

“On the contrary, other living beings, including the dragon servants, are mere slaves and food when necessary. Their lives are worthless in your eyes.” He continued.

“I’m not the one who decides a race’s worth.” The voice said.

“It’s not a criticism because other beings also don’t value lives. There are simply too many of them. Even the poorest farmers can reproduce in just one year. Thus, some parents also pay no mind to losing an infant, or another farmhand for the fields.” He said.

“You speak of tragedies in the mortal world.” The voice said.

“The biggest tragedy will be your refinement.” He said.

“Even if I don’t refine this world, it will be destroyed. We are merely taking one step ahead of the high heaven.” The voice said.

“You think like an immortal while I carry a different perspective.” Li Qiye said: “I want to return the world to all living beings. That’s why you are still standing before me. You view them as insects but in my eyes, the divine beasts are no different from other living beings, mere insects.”

“That’s an exaggeration, Sir.” The voice disagreed.

“You think you can put up a fight but I can prove you’re wrong very quickly. Without my original pursuit, I can do to you what you are trying to do to the mortals, and it’ll be worse because divine beasts have such a long lifespan. You all will become eternal slaves and not even the villainous heaven can stop my dominion.” Li Qiye said.

The voice contemplated in silence for a long moment before speaking: “We will obey your wish and never appear again.”

“There’s a misunderstanding. I’m not here for the divine beasts, only you.” Li Qiye said.

“We have no feud between us.” The voice said.

“Yes, that is true, but there are those who do not support my goal. You and Octopus, for example.” Li Qiye said.

“I’m not in opposition.” The voice said.

“But you wish to be outside of the rules. In a great plain, it is fine for a rabbit to eat grass and a lion to eat the rabbit. An immortal shouldn’t appear and devour the plain.” Li Qiye said.

“Any world will give birth to immortals or overlords.” The voice said: “It is inevitable. Do you wish to kill all immortals?”

“No, only a few, such as your group. The rest will be judged by the world.” Li Qiye shook his head.

“You speak as if being powerful is a sin.” The voice said.

“No, it is not. An Ran is stronger than you but I haven’t killed him.” Li Qiye said.

“Then why do you want to kill us? In terms of holding strong, no one had done so more than I.” The voice said.

“In the end, you won’t because you will do anything for the divine beast race.” Li Qiye said.

“I am responsible for protecting our race.” The voice said: “Are you acting as the high heaven and delivering judgment?”

“No, I am not and won’t be, I will leave it to the world’s judgment.” Li Qiye said: “But before returning everything to this world, I have to flatten it first.”

“That’s why you wish to kill me.” The voice said.

“Yes, feel free to resist.” Li Qiye said.

“I don’t think I have done anything wrong.” The voice said.

“Look into his eyes and say that.” Li Qiye said: “You won’t, and you know why.”

“Certain things must be done, just like you when you acted as the dark hand behind the curtain.” The voice said.

“Sure, and now it is time for you to face karma, it is knocking.” Li Qiye said.
